defect: The fix adds LogicalTypeId::UNKNOWN to the accepted struct-extract types because macro dummy types were later changed to UNKNOWN.
reason: The need arose from a later change of macro parameter types (#15432); the MAP support added here is untouched by the fix.

defect: The refactored string compress/decompress writes the length byte and then overwrites it (result = 0), copies sizeof(T)-1 bytes from the wrong offsets (overflowing the 12-byte inline prefix for hugeint) and asserts size < 1 for the uint8 case.
reason: The fix titled 'fix refactor bugs' rewrites exactly the byte layout logic this refactor introduced one day earlier.

defect: The fix only reformats a long REQUIRE line and removes trailing whitespace.
reason: Pure formatting change in a test file.

defect: In this file the fix only reformats the switch statement and the long exception message (clang-format).
reason: The behavioural part of the fix is in quantile.cpp; the lines in this file are only reformatted.

defect: With DECIMAL newly in LogicalType::NUMERIC, unary + is registered (twice) for the unparameterized DECIMAL type without a bind that sets width/scale, and unary - for decimals is dropped.
reason: The fix adds binds that propagate the child's decimal type for unary +/- and removes the duplicate generic-DECIMAL registration added here.

defect: round_info.should_round uses 'digit <= -5' for negative numbers although digit is uint8_t, so negative decimals are never rounded.
reason: The fix replaces the added condition with digit >= 5, repairing the rounding of negative values introduced by this change.

defect: ROUND computes pow(10, precision) and input*modifier, which overflows to inf/NaN for large precision.
reason: The overflowing pow/round computation already existed before this change, which only changed the operator template signature and precision type.

defect: Setting profiling_mode to standard or detailed now resets profiler_settings to the defaults, wiping custom profiling settings configured earlier.
reason: The fix removes the profiler_settings reset lines this change added to ProfilingModeSetting::SetLocal (along with older emit_profiler_output lines).

defect: The rewritten debug assertion computes '-1 * (T(1) << ...)'; for hugeint_t this resolves to operator*(idx_t, hugeint_t), turning -1 into 2^64-1 and making the assertion wrong.
reason: The fix changes the added -1 to T(-1) in exactly the assertion this change introduced.

defect: The fix rewrites FetchAll to scan without the hash column (optimisation) and moves UnpinData() to the start of Reset().
reason: The FetchAll code it touches was rewritten by intermediate commits, and the UnpinData-at-end ordering in Reset predates this change.

defect: The header declares BlockSink(BlockedSink) by value while the .cpp definition takes const BlockedSink &, which does not compile.
reason: The mismatch was created by a later 'tidy fix' commit (4253e0f) that changed only the .cpp; at this change both signatures matched.

defect: The fix std::moves the shared_ptr row_group_order parameter instead of copying it.
reason: A clang-tidy style/performance change with no behavioural defect.

defect: The fix passes additional l_node parent arguments to ResolvePrefixesAndMerge after its signature was extended.
reason: The call added here matched the signature at the time; the segfault (parent child pointer not updated when l_node is replaced) lies in node.cpp/leaf.cpp merge logic.

defect: When MergeNodeNLeaf grows l_node via InsertChildNode, the parent's child pointer is not updated, leaving a dangling pointer.
reason: The missing l_node parent update existed before this change, which only added the r_node parent handling that the fix keeps.

defect: Merging recurses on a local copy of the child pointer, so when l_node is grown or replaced the parent still points to the freed node.
reason: The lost-update pattern predates this change (parameters were previously passed by value); this change only switched to references and the fix adds parent propagation.

defect: The new MergeByte/MergeNodeWith* functions take Node* by value with no parent information, so InsertChildNode growing l_node leaves the caller and the parent pointing to the freed node.
reason: The fix extends exactly these newly declared functions with parent parameters to update the parent's child pointer, repairing the segfault in the merge path introduced here.

defect: The new early 'return result;' converts unique_ptr<BoundSelectNode> to unique_ptr<BoundQueryNode> implicitly, which gcc 4.9 does not accept without std::move.
reason: The fix changes this added return statement to return move(result) to restore the gcc 4.9 build.

defect: The fix removes the is_escaped flag, which at the fix's parent was set and reset within one loop iteration and therefore dead code.
reason: The flag never being reset was a real bug introduced here, but an intermediate commit already repaired it; this fix is a revert requested in review.

defect: The fix deletes commented-out serialization code and changes how the variant column type is built in GetPersistentColumnDataType.
reason: The touched code was rewritten in the 66 days between; none of the fixed lines come from this change.

defect: HeapGatherArrayVector computes array_start from the loop index i instead of the selected row col_idx, so arrays are gathered into the wrong child positions.
reason: The fix replaces the added 'i * array_size' (marked TODO by the author) with col_idx * array_size.

defect: ColumnDataCopyArray copies total_length child elements contiguously from first_offset, which is wrong when arrays are non-contiguous (selection vector) or NULL arrays lie in between.
reason: The fix switches to the sliced-child copy and disables the unsliced copy this change introduced.

defect: RESET of an aliased setting erases and resets the alias name instead of the canonical option name.
reason: This merge resolution only changed erase(name) to erase(name.ToStdString()); the use of the alias name predates it.

defect: TryGetCurrentSetting looks up generic settings by the requested key, so an alias resolves to no stored value.
reason: At this change no alias pointed to a generic setting (null_order was removed); the alias problem arose with the later alias rework (9e0ac5d).

defect: The fix reorders declarations and makes TraverseProjectionBindings a non-static member.
reason: An interface refactor following later implementation changes, not a defect repair.

defect: PrintErrorHeader now logs the header via LogFailure to stderr and again via LogFailureAnnotation to stdout, so every error header is printed twice.
reason: The fix removes the LogFailure call added here and makes LogFailureAnnotation the single output path.

defect: The fix removes the unused static Log() declaration.
reason: Dead-code cleanup in the header.

defect: The fix uses error.RawMessage() instead of Message() for the default RuntimeError and updates the arrow UDF test expectation.
reason: Using Message() in the default branch predates this change; the fix adjusts message formatting within the ongoing exception rework.

defect: Column types are read once from the first row instead of per row (so a later NULL is treated as OOM), and the sqlite callback dereferences a null renderer in TRASH mode.
reason: The fix moves sqlite3_column_type back into the per-row loop and guards the null renderer, both introduced here.

defect: The JSON renderer prints '1e999' for -inf instead of '-1e999'.
reason: The fix corrects the sign in the -inf branch this change added.

defect: The fix moves the closing brace and END_OF_EXTENSION_FILE_PREFIXES marker onto the last entry line, as the generator script expects.
reason: A formatting/generated-file layout change; the code of this change compiled and worked.

defect: ProgressData::IsValid combines its conditions with || and a non-negated invalid flag, so it reports invalid progress as valid.
reason: The inverted expression predates this change, which only appended another term; the fix's correction (with total >= 0.0) addresses the older inversion.

defect: Serializing a STRUCT vector writes a list of 'count' children instead of entries.size(), indexing entries out of bounds.
reason: The fix replaces count with entries.size() in the WriteList call this change introduced (the old code used entries.size()).

defect: The fix routes bind data creation through a new StructExtractFun::GetBindData helper.
reason: A refactor to support StructFilter::ToExpression, not a defect repair.

defect: StructFilter::ToExpression throws NotImplementedException; the fix implements it.
reason: The change added an explicit not-yet-supported stub with no callers; implementing it later is feature completion.

defect: The fix turns min_by/max_by into aliases of arg_min/arg_max and adds argmin/argmax names.
reason: This change only renamed the state type; the alias rework is a feature/API change.

defect: The fix drops the separate MinByFun/MaxByFun registrations because min_by/max_by become aliases of arg_min/arg_max.
reason: Replacing the limited standalone functions with full aliases is an API redesign rather than a repair of a defect in these registration lines.

defect: The fix replaces C-style casts with Cast<> in ParquetGetBatchInfo and other functions while resolving a merge.
reason: Style and merge cleanup; the cast code added here was functionally correct.

defect: AddBatchInfo is made const so it can be called through the const reference returned by Cast<>.
reason: The compile issue arose from merging with the later bind-data Cast change; at this change it was called through a non-const pointer.

defect: The fix removes the D_ASSERT(dynamic_cast) check from CastNoConst during merge cleanup.
reason: No defect in the added assertion is evident; dropping a debug check in a merge fix is cleanup.

defect: OpenerFileSystem does not pass its opener to DirectoryExists, CreateDirectory, RemoveDirectory and MoveFile.
reason: This change only reworked OpenFile flags and rewrapped lines; the missing opener propagation predates it or came from later signature changes.
